title: Extraño mi casa
desc: Admitting it out loud, and getting an answer you did not expect
setting: It is the second evening in a row you have not gone out, and doña Carmen has noticed.

steps.speaker: Doña Carmen
steps.es: ¿Y usted por qué anda tan callado, mijo?
steps.en: And why are you so quiet, love?

options.es: Es que extraño mi casa, doña. Nada más.
options.en: It is that I miss home, doña. That is all.
options.feedback: Say it plainly. Extrañar is the word, and this is a house where somebody is always missing somebody.
She will let it go and she will not believe it. There is no cost here to saying the true thing.
She asked because she could see it was something. Nothing closes a door that was opened for you.

steps.speaker: Doña Carmen
steps.es: Ay, mijo. Mi hijo mayor tiene ocho años de estar en Costa Rica.
steps.en: Oh, love. My eldest son has been in Costa Rica for eight years.

options.es: No sabía, doña. ¿Y lo ha podido ver?
options.en: I did not know, doña. And have you been able to see him?
options.feedback: She did not say that to compare. She said it because almost every house on this street is missing somebody, and now you know which one hers is.
Kind and short. A question would have let her keep talking, which is what she was doing.
Eight years says he cannot, for reasons nobody in the room needs explained.

steps.speaker: Doña Carmen
steps.es: Una vez. Ya tiene dos hijos que no conozco.
steps.en: Once. He has two children now that I have never met.

options.feedback: Nothing else is required. She was not looking for advice and there is none to give.
A fair question with an obvious answer. She will explain the money to you kindly.

options.es: Con el celular ya casi es igual.
options.en: With the phone it is nearly the same now.
options.feedback: It is not the same and she knows exactly how much it is not.

steps.speaker: Doña Carmen
steps.es: Por eso, mijo. Aquí usted tiene casa. Coma con nosotros.
steps.en: That is why, love. You have a home here. Eat with us.

options.es: Gracias, doña. Se lo digo de verdad.
options.en: Thank you, doña. I mean that.
options.feedback: She has just told you that missing your family is the ordinary condition of the whole street, and that you belong to hers now. Take it as it was given.
Enough, and small for what was just said to you.

options.en: I do not want to be a bother.
options.feedback: She offered you a place at her table and you argued with it. That is not modesty here, it is a refusal.
